name: SimpleFin Sync
description: Automatically import bank and credit-card transactions from SimpleFin, with correct balances, pending reconciliation, and internal-transfer linking.

release.notes: The companion now reads Wealthfolio's database live through the write-ahead log instead of a snapshot that could run days stale — fixing missed needs-a-category rows and stale daily/weekly report figures. The category sweep also covers income (deposits, credits, interest), not just spending. Deployment note: bind-mount the Wealthfolio directory rather than the bare .db file so the WAL is visible.
